experiment.cpu_fallback: PCI / NUMA / RDMA probes and the Table 5.3 gate without a GPU, plus a host-memory copy bandwidth sweep (the memory a host-staged transfer bounces through)
experiment.title: Lab 5 L2: real host topology capture, PCIe link measurement and the GDR gate

needs: an RDMA NIC (ConnectX-class or similar) on the GPU's PCIe switch
a second host on an RDMA fabric
not_runnable_parts.part: Exercise 5.15 runtime proof: NCCL NET/IB/.../GDRDMA channel lines or ib_write_bw --use_cuda

needs: root on bare metal (not a WSL2 guest)
not_runnable_parts.part: L2 capture script (capture/capture_topology.sh) with lspci -vvv ACS/LnkSta, lstopo, ibdev2netdev, LLDP

notes: Every row of the Table 5.3 checklist is built from a command or sysfs file read during this run; the raw topo -m output and the PCI scan are in results.json.
GDR gate from lab/data/path_model.yaml: a GPU-NIC pair is GDR-eligible when its relation is at most PXB.
Bandwidth: median of >= 5 timed repetitions after 3 warm-ups (CUDA events on the GPU, perf_counter on the CPU).
